race.comment: FROZEN TIDE (5) was only beaten by a nose at Bendigo last start, ad he has been thereabouts in most of his runs this season. He has won over a mile, and the high weight conditions of this race will suit him right down to the ground. He is set to go one better in this. CRACKERJACK HATCH (8) made an early bid for glory off a wide run at Mt Gambier nearly 4 weeks ago, and was only claimed late that day, ending up in fifth place. She is not having much luck with a run of bad gates, but she is due a change in fortune, and she is well worth each-way consideration. MUTSUHITO (6) flipped some average form on its head when winning his last start at Manangatang just over 3 weeks ago. This field is not much harder, and back to his home track, he can repeat. SALINA SPECIAL (3) won in BM52 company at Wodonga last start, and that form reads good enough for this highweight assignment, so stick with him.
